summary: The Sheets plugin conversion layer provides bidirectional translation between Barkpark's internal sheet document format and external spreadsheet formats (xlsx, csv, tsv, markdown, HTML), with full round-trip fidelity for values, formulas, number formats, styles, merges, and frozen panes. It exposes HTTP endpoints for import, export, and cell-granular ops, acting as the thin plugin wiring over the core Sheets engine.

intentions.title: Guarantee lossless xlsx round-trip for structured data
intentions.evidence: XlsxImport and XlsxExport mirror each other exactly: col_widths use the same px/7 factor, fmt classes are canonical strings that re-classify to themselves (Fmt.ex), date serials use the same epoch, merges/frozen panes/styles all survive the round-trip

intentions.title: Provide a safe, capped import boundary against hostile or oversized xlsx inputs
intentions.evidence: xlsx_import.ex enforces cell_cap across all tabs with early-halt, clips and sanitizes merge ranges against occupied bounds, drops cells beyond Excel grid bounds (XFD/1048576), rescues zip parse exceptions, and filters out unsupported features (charts, pivots, conditional formatting) without erroring

intentions.title: Abstract number-format semantics into a stable six-class vocabulary
intentions.evidence: Fmt.ex defines exactly six semantic classes (fixed, percent, currency, thousands, date, datetime), maps all ECMA-376 builtin numFmtIds plus custom format codes by heuristic pattern, and provides a canonical export format string per class — decoupling the data model from xlsx's hundreds of raw format strings

intentions.title: Enable multiplayer sheet editing via a session-backed ops API
intentions.evidence: OpsController delegates all cell/structural ops to Sheets.Session.apply_ops/3 which handles validation, recompute, delta broadcast, and debounced persistence; per-user undo/redo identity rides the op payload; errors are per-op (not atomic), with clear 503/retry-after on session unavailability

intentions.title: Serve read-your-writes consistency on exports
intentions.evidence: ExportController calls Session.flush/2 before every read, surfaces 503 flush_failed with retry-after:2 when persist fails rather than serving stale data, and falls back to published document when no draft exists

intentions.title: Support multi-format data egress for downstream consumers
intentions.evidence: ExportController serves xlsx (whole doc), csv/tsv (per-tab with ?tab= param), markdown table, and standalone HTML — covering machine-readable, human-readable, and embeddable formats from a single document
